resources.string:
This is a D-pad-navigable keyboard for devices with a hardware gamepad, such as the Xperia Play.

To use it:
1. Tap "Open Input Method Settings" below
2. Enable "Play Keyboard"
3. Switch to it from any text field

Once active, use the D-pad to move the highlight between keys and X (or the DPAD centre press) to select a key. O deletes, Triangle switches between letters and symbols, and Square toggles shift.
